label: ha select
description: A list of options in Home Assistant. Sends the option chosen in HA. Wire the current option back to the input so HA shows it; left unwired, the node confirms each choice itself. 'On start' picks the value at flow start. Needs an ha device node in the flow.

properties.name: onStart
properties.label: on start
properties.help: A start value, one of the options, or unknown, or restore (the last value it showed).
